hunks.baseline: The moment the Sound Transmission pierced his ear, Jeok Cheongang moved with remarkable speed—and complete naturalness.
hunks.sol: The moment he heard the Sound Transmission, Jeok Cheongang moved with remarkable speed—and made it look perfectly natural.

hunks.baseline: The man disguised as a customer tried to protest, but the terrifying energy coming from Jeok Cheongang’s grip on his wrist left him gaping.
hunks.sol: The man disguised as a customer tried to protest, but the terrifying qi flowing through Jeok Cheongang’s grip on his wrist left him gaping.

hunks.baseline: The pressure felt like it would crush his entire body.
hunks.sol: The pressure felt as though it would crush his entire body.

hunks.baseline: He instinctively summoned his internal energy to protect his wrist, but it was useless.
hunks.sol: He instinctively summoned his internal energy to protect his wrist. It did no good.

hunks.baseline: This wasn’t a man. He was a beast born to hunt—a predator.
hunks.sol: This wasn’t a man. He was a born beast of prey. A predator.

hunks.baseline: Frozen stiff against his own will, the man was dragged deep into the textile shop.
hunks.sol: Frozen stiff against his will, the man was dragged deep into the textile shop.

hunks.baseline: Between the towering stacks of cotton cloth and silk, two figures emerged like ghosts from a shadowy corner no one had noticed.
hunks.sol: Between towering stacks of cotton cloth and silk, two figures emerged like ghosts from a shadowy corner.

hunks.baseline: In the faint lamplight, the faces of two young men—both appearing to be around thirty—came into view.
hunks.sol: In the faint lamplight, the faces of two young men, both around thirty, came into view.

hunks.baseline: One had an expression as flat as if he were chewing sand. The other was handsome, but his upturned eyes were so sly-looking they were his one flaw.
hunks.sol: One wore an expression as dry as if he’d been chewing sand. The other was handsome, but his sharply upturned eyes made him look almost sly.

hunks.baseline: By their respective traits, neither had the sort of face that made dealing with people easy.
hunks.sol: Neither had the sort of face that made dealing with people easy.

hunks.baseline: The especially austere-looking young man spoke first.
hunks.sol: The especially grim-looking young man spoke first, in a painfully awkward tone.

hunks.baseline: In a painfully awkward tone, he said, “Hey, Mr. Jeok. What’s going on?”
hunks.sol: “Hey, Mr. Jeok. What’s going on?”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang answered, “Hey, Mr. Jeok? You’ve got a death wish, don’t you?”
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang answered, “Hey, Mr. Jeok? Are you that eager to shit blood?”

hunks.baseline: “Can’t you tell by looking? How did you survive as a wandering martial artist with that kind of sense?”
hunks.sol: “Can’t you tell by looking? How did you survive as a wandering martial artist with that little sense?”

hunks.baseline: The austere young man bowed his head. Song Ilseom carefully spoke up.
hunks.sol: The grim-looking young man bowed his head. Song Ilseom spoke again, more carefully this time.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang gave the brief reply, then added, “But he used Sound Transmission. He introduced himself with a title that starts with ‘Blazing’ and ends with ‘Dragon.’”
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang gave the brief reply, then added, “But he used Sound Transmission. Mentioned a sobriquet that starts with ‘Blazing’ and ends with ‘Dragon.’”

hunks.baseline: “Make sure the shop is secured. Oh, first, circle the area. If you see anyone suspicious, grab the bastard and bring him here too.”
hunks.sol: “Lock up properly. First, take a look around the shop. If you spot anyone suspicious, grab the bastard and bring him here too.”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. But what if there’s no other choice…?”
hunks.sol: “Yes. But if I have no choice…?”

hunks.baseline: Song Ilseom bowed politely and left at once. The man who’d heard their conversation felt his knees weaken.
hunks.sol: Song Ilseom bowed politely and left at once. The man who’d heard their conversation felt his knees go weak.

hunks.baseline: *Could they be… an assassin organization?*
hunks.sol: *Could they be… assassins?*

hunks.baseline: As his mouth went dry, the other young man who had stayed behind spoke up.
hunks.sol: As his mouth went dry, the other young man spoke up.

hunks.baseline: “It’ll be difficult to bring everyone right away. One of them is out at the moment.”
hunks.sol: “It’ll be difficult to bring everyone right away. One of them is out.”

hunks.baseline: “Damn it, what kind of goddamn idiot can’t sit still for a minute?”
hunks.sol: “Damn it, which little shit couldn’t stand staying put for five minutes?”

hunks.baseline: “She’s allowed to go out for a while. Right. Of course. She must’ve gone to check on the situation nearby. How thoughtful of her.”
hunks.sol: “She’s allowed to go out for a while. Of course she is. She must’ve gone to check the situation nearby. How thoughtful of her.”

hunks.baseline: “Quit looking at me like that and go bring the other freeloaders.”
hunks.sol: “Quit looking at me like that and go fetch the other freeloaders.”

hunks.baseline: “I told you not to look at me like that. Do my words sound like a load of bullshit to you?”
hunks.sol: “I told you not to look at me like that. Do my words sound like bullshit to you?”

hunks.baseline: “It’s just that my eyes have looked this way since I was a child, so there’s nothing I can do about it… No. I’m sorry. If I get the chance someday, I’ll be reborn.”
hunks.sol: “My eyes have looked this way since I was a child, so there’s nothing I can do about—no. I’m sorry. If I get the chance someday, I’ll be reborn.”

hunks.baseline: “Good. That way you can reincarnate—and learn to look at people properly.”
hunks.sol: “Good. That way you can reincarnate. Maybe you’ll have kinder-looking eyes next time.”

hunks.baseline: With a weak reply, the young man with the sorrowfully upturned eyes, Sama Pyo, left. Jeok Cheongang suddenly reached out toward something.
hunks.sol: Sama Pyo, the young man cursed with sorrowfully upturned eyes, left with a feeble reply. Jeok Cheongang suddenly reached toward something.

hunks.baseline: His energy extended without form, and the air around them trembled.
hunks.sol: Qi stretched out, invisible, and the air around them trembled.

hunks.baseline: The man’s pupils trembled too as he watched a wooden chest fly toward them, suspended in midair.
hunks.sol: So did the man’s pupils as he watched a wooden chest float through the air toward them.

hunks.baseline: With nothing more than a casual flick of his hand.
hunks.sol: With one casual wave of his hand.

hunks.baseline: Something clicked for the man, and he cautiously spoke.
hunks.sol: A possibility occurred to him, and he spoke cautiously.

hunks.baseline: “Could your title be the Fire King?”
hunks.sol: “Could your sobriquet be the Fire King?”

hunks.baseline: Instead of answering, Jeok Cheongang blinked at him as if he were some curious creature. Then he kicked the man in the shin as fast as a flash.
hunks.sol: Instead of answering, Jeok Cheongang blinked at him as if he were some curious creature. Then he kicked the man in the shin like a flash of lightning.

hunks.baseline: “You little shit! You’re still wet behind the ears, and half your tongue seems to be missing. What was that—‘you’?”
hunks.sol: “You little shit. You’re still wet behind the ears, and half your tongue seems to be missing. What was that—‘your’?”

hunks.baseline: The man’s grappling technique, which he’d practiced until his arms were bruised, and his footwork technique, which he’d drilled until the muscles in his legs screamed, were useless now.
hunks.sol: The grappling technique he’d practiced until his arms were bruised and the footwork technique he’d drilled until his leg muscles screamed were useless now.

hunks.baseline: After getting hit in the shin, the stomach, the chest, and finally the bridge of the nose, the man collapsed like a puppet with its strings cut.
hunks.sol: After blows to the shin, stomach, chest, and finally the bridge of his nose, the man collapsed like a kite with its string cut.

hunks.baseline: Of course, even passing out wasn’t allowed.
hunks.sol: Of course, he wasn’t even allowed to pass out.

hunks.baseline: He sprang upright, rising far faster than he’d fallen. His voice trembled as he spoke.
hunks.sol: He sprang to his feet far faster than he’d fallen. His voice trembled as he spoke.

hunks.baseline: “Are you the Fire King, Great Hero Jeok Cheongang?”
hunks.sol: “Are you Great Hero Jeok Cheongang, the Fire King?”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang had somehow pulled the chest closer with Seizing an Object Through Empty Space and perched on it. His expression was as satisfied as a surgeon who’d just completed a difficult operation.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang had perched on the chest he’d drawn over with Seizing an Object Through Empty Space. He looked as satisfied as a surgeon who’d just completed a difficult operation.

hunks.baseline: “Your severed tongue has finally grown back in the right place. Good. I am Jeok Cheongang. And who are you?”
hunks.sol: “Your severed tongue has finally grown back in the right place. Yes, this old man is Jeok Cheongang. And who are you?”

hunks.baseline: “I am…”
hunks.sol: “This humble servant…”

hunks.baseline: “I don’t need to know a nobody like you’s name. Just tell me who you work for. I can tell at a glance you’re an eunuch, anyway.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t need your name. Just tell me who you work for. I can tell you’re a eunuch.”

hunks.baseline: “What? Is that such a big secret?”
hunks.sol: “What? Was that such a big secret?”

hunks.baseline: The man—or rather, the eunuch—was momentarily speechless. Jeok Cheongang chuckled and continued.
hunks.sol: The man—or rather, the eunuch—was momentarily speechless. Jeok Cheongang gave a short laugh and continued.

hunks.baseline: “I’ll admit, you did a pretty good job disguising yourself. That human-skin mask, even your beard—it all looks natural, like it’s your own. But you can’t fool this old man with something as basic as that.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll admit, you’ve put together a convincing disguise. That human-skin mask, even the beard—they look like they’re yours. But that’s not enough to fool this old man.”

hunks.baseline: “I felt your pulse earlier. You didn’t have nearly enough yang qi for a man. Now, tell me—which is more likely in the imperial palace courtyard: running into a eunuch, or running into a martial artist without balls? I don’t need to spell it out, do I?”
hunks.sol: “When I took your pulse earlier, I found you had nowhere near the yang qi a man ought to have. Now, which is more likely near the imperial palace: meeting a martial artist without balls, or meeting a eunuch? I don’t need to spell it out, do I?”

hunks.baseline: The eunuch swallowed hard. He was impressed by Jeok Cheongang’s keen judgment, of course, but more than that, he couldn’t believe how little the man’s attitude had changed despite knowing he was an eunuch.
hunks.sol: The eunuch swallowed hard. Jeok Cheongang’s judgment was sharp, but what unsettled him more was that knowing he was a eunuch hadn’t changed the man’s attitude at all.

hunks.baseline: “Stop rambling and answer what I asked. Exactly where in the imperial palace do you serve? Are you under that eunuch who’s Prince Shangshan’s right hand? The East Depot? Or are you one of the ones licking the Emperor’s…”
hunks.sol: “Stop rambling and answer my question. Which part of the palace do you serve? Are you under that eunuch who’s Prince Shangshan’s right hand? The East Depot? Or do you lick the Emperor’s…”

hunks.baseline: “The East Depot, huh? The place that gathers the most persistent and vicious eunuchs in the world. But why would an East Depot eunuch come all the way here?”
hunks.sol: “The East Depot, eh? The place where they gather the most stubborn and vicious eunuchs under heaven. So why has one of you come all the way here?”

hunks.baseline: “The Blazing Flame Divine Dragon—no, your Disciple asked me to deliver a few messages.”
hunks.sol: “The Blazing Flame Divine Dragon—no, your Disciple asked me to pass on several messages.”

hunks.baseline: “Is the Emperor laying a trap?”
hunks.sol: “And the Emperor isn’t laying a trap?”

hunks.baseline: “That sounds plausible. But with the East Depot’s intelligence network, it wouldn’t be surprising if you’d found out somehow anyway. How are you going to prove it?”
hunks.sol: “That sounds plausible. But with the East Depot’s intelligence network, it wouldn’t be strange if you’d found out some other way. How will you prove it?”

hunks.sol: The eunuch waited in dread. Fortunately, Jeok Cheongang knew exactly what the clumsily pronounced word meant.

hunks.baseline: The monsters from the other world that had stained the realm of immortals with blood.

hunks.sol: And only two people under heaven knew about them: Jin Taekyung and himself.

hunks.baseline: “Hmm. So he definitely sent you.”
hunks.sol: “Hmm. He definitely sent you.”

hunks.baseline: The eunuch wanted to say that calling a eunuch a castrate was about the rudest thing you could do, but he held his tongue.
hunks.sol: The eunuch wanted to say that calling a eunuch a castrate was about as rude as it got, but he held his tongue.

hunks.baseline: His only sensible move was to leave as soon as possible.
hunks.sol: His best course was to leave as quickly as possible.

hunks.baseline: He reached deep into his clothing, took out a small sealed tube, and handed it over. Jeok Cheongang’s eyes grew serious.
hunks.sol: He reached deep into his robes, took out a small tube, and handed it over. Jeok Cheongang’s eyes grew serious.

hunks.baseline: “Is this the missive Jin Taekyung told you to deliver to me?”
hunks.sol: “Is this the missive Jin Taekyung told you to deliver?”

hunks.baseline: “Hong Jin? I haven’t met him, but I heard about him on the way here. Apparently, he’s a pretty decent eunuch.”
hunks.sol: “Hong Jin? I’ve never met him, but I heard about him on the way here. A fairly decent eunuch, apparently.”

hunks.baseline: “……Yes. The person I serve is on close terms with him. He said the contents would help with what you’re going to do.”
hunks.sol: “……Yes. The person I serve is close to him. He said the contents would help with what you’re going to do.”

hunks.baseline: “That’s right. I’m only a messenger.”
hunks.sol: “That’s all. I’m only a messenger.”

hunks.baseline: That was as far as the eunuch’s orders went.
hunks.sol: That was the extent of the eunuch’s orders.

hunks.baseline: He hurried out of the vast slaughterhouse—or rather, the textile shop—using a footwork technique. Left alone, Jeok Cheongang broke the seals and took out two rolled-up missives.
hunks.sol: He hurried out of the vast slaughterhouse—or rather, the textile shop—using a footwork technique. Left alone, Jeok Cheongang broke the seals and drew out two rolled-up missives.

hunks.baseline: The smell of oil-treated paper mingled with the stale air inside the textile shop.
hunks.sol: The smell of oil-treated paper mingled with the stale air inside the shop.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang quickly read the information prepared with help from the East Depot, after Jin Taekyung’s missive began with the eloquent line, *“I’m afraid we may be screwed.”* He let out a quiet sigh.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung’s missive opened with the immortal line *“Looks like we’re screwed.”* Jeok Cheongang read it, then quickly went through the information prepared with the East Depot’s help. He let out a quiet sigh.

hunks.baseline: And just then—
hunks.sol: And then—

hunks.baseline: Flames from Samadhi True Fire consumed both missives, twisting and writhing in the darkness.
hunks.sol: Flames from Samadhi True Fire swallowed both missives, writhing in the darkness.

hunks.baseline: As Jeok Cheongang silently watched the missives turn to ash and vanish with a soft rustle in the blink of an eye—
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang silently watched the papers turn to ash and crumble away in the blink of an eye.

hunks.sol: “Holed up in a corner sleeping, were they?”

hunks.sol: “Taishan drank all the liquor Elder Namho had hidden away.”

hunks.sol: For a brief, tempting moment, Jeok Cheongang imagined choking Taishan and Namho at the same time. Then he sighed deeply.
